title: Night Rain on a Cozy Veranda | 1 Hour of Real Rain Sounds
description:
Shelter under a warm lantern while night rain falls across a cool courtyard. An hour-long arrangement of four real rain field recordings from different locations, edited as long, unrepeated passages with gentle transitions. Natural changes in rainfall, nearby drips and occasional thunder remain part of the atmosphere.

A calm background for reading, winding down, or simply watching the rain. The veranda is an AI-generated scene with added rain animation; the sound comes from the real recordings credited below.
